books.title: Geometric measure theory and variational problems: a first reading
books.author: Stack Project of Geometric Measure Theory and Variational Problems contributors
books.description: Original exposition connecting classical GMT with minimal surfaces, Almgren-Pitts min-max theory, the volume spectrum, CMC problems, and Allen-Cahn theory. Obstacle problems and mean curvature flow have introductory scope notes. The source inventory identifies the supplied editions; source scans are not distributed. Cited theorems without local proofs are marked in the text.
